prompts.lane:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production 2D game environment sprite, transparent PNG, a horizontal modular defensive causeway floor strip for a cooperative defense battlefield.
Primary request: richly paint an ancient fortress stone path to replace a plain line in a game. It must read clearly as WALKABLE GROUND beneath small characters, not as a UI border or elevated bridge.
Style: polished Korean collectible RPG environment art, hand-painted detailed basalt/slate paving, restrained engraved antique bronze edge inlays, small cool teal rune lights integrated in the masonry. Match a dark blue moonlit gothic castle courtyard with wet stone and faint warm torch reflections. Crisp material texture, elegant and serious.
Composition: very wide landscape canvas, approximately 3:1. One straight horizontal ground segment from left to right. Camera is a modest elevated orthographic view suitable for a 2.5D side-view battlefield; no horizon or vanishing point. Keep the walkable stone strip at a constant width, its front/back boundaries parallel. Broad open paved center, worn low border stones and sparse recessed illuminated seams. Completely flat ground; NO railings, standing torches, pillars or walls. The strip is complete and uncut with a small transparent margin at both ends. Gently irregular outer stone edges and soft contact shading that fades to real transparency, leaving the rest of the canvas transparent.
Constraints: single isolated reusable floor asset only. True alpha background, no backdrop, no checkerboard painted into the artwork, no text, letters, symbols resembling readable writing, arrows, characters, monsters, emblem, watermark, UI, or border frame. Glow must be baked into the art and restrained so units remain legible.
prompts.core:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production 2D game objective sprite, transparent PNG, the shared Guardian Crystal for a cooperative fortress defense game.
Primary request: an impressive magical guardian crystal monument that replaces a plain geometric diamond. A tall luminous mint/teal crystal with a few carefully shaped asymmetric prismatic facets, seated in an ornate dark stone and antique bronze protective cradle. The crystal is intact and precious, with a living blue-white inner light, subtle gold inlay and carved structural details. Its base is a broad low round fortress pedestal, grounded and stable, with engraved ring details, a few smaller integrated crystal facets and a restrained aqua rune halo painted on the stone.
Style: premium hand-painted Korean collectible RPG environment prop, detailed materials and dimensional light, readable iconic silhouette at small mobile size. Match a dark blue moonlit gothic castle courtyard of wet slate and warm bronze torch accents. Elegant seriousness, no toy look, no flat vector or CSS gradient appearance.
Composition: portrait or square isolated sprite, entire monument including the top tip, outer base and soft grounded light pool fully visible with comfortable transparent margins. Camera elevated modestly, almost front view with a visible elliptical top plane of the round pedestal; suited to a 2.5D side-on battlefield. The object should be wider at its grounded base, crystal rising from its center. Lighting integrated into the image, gently fading to transparent around the silhouette.
Constraints: true transparent alpha background; no full scene, sky, background buildings, characters, UI, text, letters, numbers, watermark, checkerboard or rectangular glow backdrop. One complete single guardian crystal monument only, not a sprite sheet or multiple options. Detailed authored raster art, no plain geometric placeholder.
